item.title: Omokage Railback
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiqo Soft
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 6.39/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 面影レイルバック
  • 英語名: Omokage Railback

别名

  • Propose Sakusen

あらすじ

During Masashi’s last summer as a student, it was decided that he would transfer schools due to his non-blood-related older sister Juri’s work as the young manager of Yoshioka Construction. His new school would be in the small rural town of Yagurana, located at the end of the railroad. He met the young land-owner Iroha, who vows to protect the land from corporations, and started going to school with her. However, the reason why he was there was because of Yoshioka Construction’s desire to develop the land. Moreover, he was the heir of the corporation itself.

  • 日本語名: ひとなつの
  • 英語名: Hitonatsu no

别名

  • ひとなつの 右原攻略ＤＬＣ

あらすじ

During the summer of his third year, Masaru transfered to Kamakura Gakuen in his hometown which he hadn’t visited for nearly four and a half years. He used to pretend to be a ‘hero’ with his osananajimis Eri, Masaru and Miyuki, but they’ve since moved on from that childish stage. He didn’t think that things would change, but something happened during over the years he was gone.

item.title: Sakura Sakura Festival!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiqo Soft
  • 発売日: 2013-04-26
  • スコア: 7.409999999999999/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくらさくら FESTIVAL！
  • 英語名: Sakura Sakura Festival!

别名

  • さくらさくら FESTIVAL！ ‐この期に及んでまだ選べない！‛？‐

あらすじ

This is the fandisk for love triangle ADV Sakura Sakura. Tooru was still undecided between Nanako and Sakura, but it had gotten to the point not only for him, but for everyone else around too, that he make a decision. A girl who said she did not have long to live told him about a legend that eternal love would be blessed upon those who confess at the Rintoku Academy culture festival, and that she wished to confess to the one she loved too. He decided to help her out and at the same time vowed to choose his true love on that special day.

item.title: Sakura Sakura
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiqo Soft
  • 発売日: 2009-06-26
  • スコア: 7.12/10 (599 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくらさくら
  • 英語名: Sakura Sakura

あらすじ

The Dorm Guardian vs. The School Guardian

Inaba Tooru has always dreamed of living a co-ed life. That’s why, when he finally managed to transfer into the renowned Rintoku Academy, he immediately fell head over heels for two Sakuras!

Sakura Nanako’s classes are strict, but at home, she turns into an overbearing mother.

Kirishima Sakura may seem cold and unfriendly, but she is always ready to lend a helping hand as the class representative.

item.title: Yotsunoha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiqo Soft
  • 発売日: 2006-01-27
  • スコア: 6.540000000000001/10 (246 人評価)
  • 日本語名: よつのは
  • 英語名: Yotsunoha

あらすじ

A quest in search of our school memories.

At the end of summer break, our school closed down. On our last day together, we put our true feelings inside a time capsule, and promised to meet again in three years. The promised summer came. With it came things that did and did not change between us. The quest in search of our school memories has begun.
